card.text: Saturn's moon with the most reflective surface in the solar system.

introduction.text: Icy spray from warm fractures, called tiger stripes, comes from a global ocean and forms Saturn's E ring.

normal.title: Schenk–McKinnon mosaic
normal.summary: Images aligned to a common shape; detail varies and shadows in the photographs remain.

elevation.title: Stereo and shading terrain model
elevation.summary: Height relative to the source ellipsoid, clipped at ±1 km, from stereo and shading.

shape.title: JPL v2 SPC shape model
shape.summary: Plain surface over a simplified version of JPL's corrected v2 shape; the original v1 solution is not used.

ice-absorption.title: Partial Cassini VIMS water-ice signature
ice-absorption.summary: Water-ice absorption near 2.02 µm where Cassini saw it. Values depend on viewing angle and grain size; not ice amounts.

infrared-ratio.title: Partial Cassini VIMS spectral ratio
infrared-ratio.summary: A 3.1/1.66 µm ratio sensitive to ice, where Cassini saw it. It does not measure temperature or crystallinity.
